profileLabel: Strongly institution-supporting on accountability bills (medium confidence)
summary: Caloocan 2nd District representative with 61 principal-authored bills. Authored FOI, an independent flood-control investigation commission, anti-dynasty rules through family-office limits, mandatory campaign platforms and debates, and a national cybersecurity agency. Co-authored AMLC strengthening, minimum wage, gig-economy regulation and Safe Spaces Act amendments.
caveat: Evidence is bills only; no committee conduct or votes reviewed. Labor and gender co-authorships are each one issue and left unscored.
